morning.caption:
North Carolina's drought now reaches 6.2 million people. Durham had 76 days of easily accessible water on November 17 and has paid more than $4 million for 898 million gallons bought from Cary and OWASA, because it has no plant of its own on Jordan Lake.

afternoon.caption:
American Water told employees on November 20 that merger planning with Essential Utilities is largely complete. Illinois became the fourth state to approve the all-stock deal, with settlements pending in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, North Carolina and Texas. Closing is targeted for the end of Q1 2027.

More: watercapitalwire.com

evening.caption:
Veolia has won nearly €200 million of desalination contracts in the UAE and Oman: technology for Sharjah's 410,000 cubic meter a day Al Hamriyah plant, targeting 2.75 kWh per cubic meter, and five years operating Oman's Al Asilah plant.
